# Sanad Agent Support

Choose the narrowest channel that fits the request.

| Need | Destination |
|---|---|
| Quick help, setup guidance, or community conversation | Sanad Agent Discord after its public invite is published (`https://discord.gg/RPTJ2X9rn`) |
| Reproducible bug | GitHub Bug Report form |
| Installation or update failure | GitHub Installation / Update form |
| Feature idea or architectural proposal | GitHub Discussions, then an Issue only after the direction is accepted |
| Documentation correction | GitHub Documentation form |
| Vulnerability or sensitive security detail | GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting or `security@eaststarai.com` |
| Conduct report | `community@eaststarai.com` |

Before opening public work, search existing Discussions, Issues, and pull requests. Remove tokens, credentials, personal paths, private repository names, user content, and unrelated logs. Never upload an unredacted diagnostic bundle.

Support and triage are provided on a best-effort basis. The project does not promise a fixed response time. Urgency labels are assigned by maintainers after triage; they are not a support SLA.

Discord is not a system of record. Reproducible bugs move to Issues, accepted ideas move from Discussions to Issues, and durable technical decisions move to the owning documentation.
